name: Yamaha P-143 Digital Piano Bundle, 88-Key Weighted Musical Keyboard, Stand, Bench, Music Rest, Sustain Foot Switch

dimensions.raw: Dimensions (with optional stand) Width 1,326 mm [52-3/16"]; Height 744 mm [29-5/16"] (with music rest: 922 mm [36-5/16"]); Depth 318 mm [12-1/2"] (with music rest: 320 mm [12-5/8"]). Amazon's Measurements row: Item Dimensions D x W x H 24"D x 14"W x 20.5"H
dimensions.source: Yamaha USA's P-143 specs page, 'Dimensions (with optional stand)', read in Chrome 2026-11-01. Amazon's own row can't be the piano (its maker says 52 3/16" wide), so it isn't used. The bench has no measurement row on either page.

notes: In Andrew's Amazon cart, qty 1 (2026-11-01). He decided to buy ("let's commit these purchases"); no order confirmation yet, so shortlisted, not ordered (F-08). Shipped and sold by Amazon, delivery Nov 2 as read 2026-11-01, 30-day returns, a return shipping fee may apply. The bundle's bench isn't drawn: no page gives its size, and it tucks under the keyboard, so a layout keeps 30" in front of the keys for it, as F-35 does for a desk chair. Amplifier speakers face the back. Flags: fits.
